title: Relay tests call run_mailbox_relay_wake_batch once and assume every pending home wake is delivered within its 2 s budget
outcome: Relay tests that need every pending home wake delivered drain them deterministically: repeated bounded batches until none is undelivered, bounded by the obligation count rather than time. None depends on one batch finishing inside the worker's 2 s wall-clock budget or the 2 s writer-lock budgets.
acceptance: Relay tests call run_mailbox_relay_wake_batch once and assume every pending home wake is delivered within its 2 s budget is done
